name: Adriana C. Mitre
office: Little Lake City School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 2

items.text: Adriana C. Mitre is a human resources and payroll manager running for the Little Lake City School District board. Mitre says budget transparency should be a top priority. She would prioritize student and classroom investments over facilities and administrative costs. She says open communication about district finances is essential to build trust.
